messages.author: 62fa83ea2a492d90
messages.subject: Missing sleep detection after 10 days
parts:
Hi all,

I'm fairly new to GGIR and am just now starting my data analyses. Upon visual inspection, I see this trend in the file summary reports for all participants, which is that sleep is not detected after Day 10 or Day 11. Any inputs on how to correct this are welcome!

Please see attached screenshot and refer to the following code that I'm using: 
GGIR(
             mode=c(1,2,3,4,5),
             datadir="DATA_DIR",
             outputdir="OUTPUT_DIR",
             do.report=c(2,4,5),
             #=====================
             # Part 2
             #=====================
             strategy = 1,
             hrs.del.start = 0,          hrs.del.end = 0,
             maxdur = 9,                 includedaycrit = 16,
             qwindow=c(0,24),
             mvpathreshold =c(100),
             bout.metric = 6,
             excludefirstlast = FALSE,
             includenightcrit = 16,
             #=====================
             # Part 3 + 4
             #=====================
             def.noc.sleep = 1,
             outliers.only = FALSE,
             criterror = 4,
             do.visual = TRUE,
             nnights = c(),
             #=====================
             # Part 5
             #=====================
             threshold.lig = c(30), threshold.mod = c(100),  threshold.vig = c(400),
             boutcriter = 0.8,      boutcriter.in = 0.9,     boutcriter.lig = 0.8,
             boutcriter.mvpa = 0.8, boutdur.in = c(1,10,30), boutdur.lig = c(1,10),
             boutdur.mvpa = c(1),
             includedaycrit.part5 = 2/3,
             #=====================
             # Visual report
             #=====================
             timewindow = c("WW"),
             visualreport=TRUE)

messages.author: 376dbfd9a2797b83
messages.subject: Re: Missing sleep detection after 10 days
parts:
Hi An

I think you have to set your maxdur= in part 2 greater than 9, otherwise it will only analyse the first 9 days. Hope this solves your issue!

messages.author: a3527f6489543e9b
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Re: Missing sleep detection after 10 days
parts:
Hi Maya

GGIR would only analyze data for the number of days that you've specified through the argument maxdur. You can choose to either leave this argument out (so that all recording days will be analysed) or increase it to 13 if that is your last recording days. 

Thank you.

Best regards,
John.

messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Re: Missing sleep detection after 10 days
parts:
Hi,

Just wanted to add that maxdur = 0 (default value) would analyse all days available in your files (even if they are not consistent in your files).

Best,
Jairo
